qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Challenger telecom operator in Switzerland (#2 behind Swisscom); relies heavily on promotional discounts and Yallo discount sub-brand to defend market share; coax broadband base faces steady FTTH migration losses, yielding sub-10% ROIC and zero real pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (gate_3b_pricing_and_proof = 'N', REJECT). Swiss #2 challenger relies on aggressive discounting and its Yallo sub-brand to retain subscribers against Swisscom and Salt, generating sub-10% ROIC and flat-to-declining real ARPU with no pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from Liberty Global in late 2024, Sunrise operates mobile and hybrid-fiber-coax (HFC) networks in Switzerland. It carries high leverage (3.5x-4.5x EBITDA, BB- credit rating) while facing continuous customer losses on coax to Swisscom/utility fiber networks. Lack of pricing power and sub-10% ROIC fail Gate 3b.
